title: Magic3D: High-Resolution Text-to-3D Content Creation
layout_note: Two optimisation stages placed side by side (not stacked): stage 1 in a pink rounded panel, stage 2 in a green rounded panel, each with the 3D representation outside its left edge; a single text prompt box spans both panels from above, and a bottom row of labels and a thick green arrow states the representation hand-off (Instant NGP -> 3D mesh -> high-resolution 3D mesh model).
grouping: Each stage is a tinted rounded panel (light red for 'Low-resolution optimization', light green for 'High-resolution optimization') with a large hand-written-style numeral '1.' / '2.' in the matching dark colour at the top-left and a bold title at the top-right. The update arrow back to each stage's 3D model takes the panel's colour (red, green).
shapes_depth: Diffusion priors are drawn as 3-D receding stacks of thin slabs in a rainbow gradient (blue to orange to blue), the encoder as a purple-to-blue receding stack; cameras are wireframe frustums; the rendered image is a white tilted card. 3D models are real renders (a voxel-grid rabbit in an octree wireframe, a coloured mesh rabbit, a large final textured rabbit). Grey thin arrows inside panels, a thick gradient green arrow along the bottom.
proposed_highlight: The text prompt is a white rounded box with a glowing yellow halo at top centre, and two thick yellow arrows drop from it into the two diffusion priors; the stage numerals and tinted panels make the coarse-to-fine split the main message, with 'image' and 'latent' set in bold under each prior to mark the difference.
lesson: Show a coarse-to-fine method as two tinted panels with identical internal wiring (render -> add noise -> prior -> L_SDS -> curved update arrow back to the 3D model), so the only visible differences between the stages are the ones that matter.
notes: venue = arXiv (remembered venue: CVPR 2023; not printed on the arXiv first page); year = arXiv preprint year. Equation elements: the L_SDS labels; operator glyphs: circled plus / minus for noise addition and subtraction.

arrangement.units: two tinted rounded panels (pink stage 1, green stage 2) each holding render -> noise -> diffusion prior -> L_SDS; the 3D representation for each stage sits just outside the panel's left edge, the final model at the far right outside both
arrangement.inputs_as: a quoted text prompt in a yellow-glowing rounded box spanning both panels; the initial 3D representation is a rendered voxel-grid rabbit at the left
arrangement.losses_at: inside each stage panel at its right end (L_SDS over a residual image), with a coloured curved 'update' arrow running back under the panel to the 3D model
arrangement.shared: the single text prompt box feeds both stages by two yellow arrows

taxonomy.note: training-free here means the diffusion priors are frozen and only the 3D representation is optimised per prompt via score distillation

core.what: two tinted optimization panels left to right, '1. Low-resolution optimization' (red) and '2. High-resolution optimization' (green), each the same render-noise-prior-SDS loop, with the 3-D representation of each stage placed before its panel

relations.form: a red panel and a green panel built from the same parts (camera render, noise ⊕, diffusion prior, ⊖, L_SDS), with a bottom green arrow 'Instant NGP representation → 3D mesh (DMTet) → after optimization → High-resolution 3D mesh model'
in each stage a long curved 'update' arrow, coloured with the panel's tint, returns from L_SDS beneath the panel to the 3-D representation on its left
one yellow-glowing prompt box 'a stuffed grey rabbit holding a pretend carrot' spans the top, with yellow arrows bending down into both diffusion priors
inside each panel left to right: orange render arrow from the camera to a rendered image, ⊕ with noise, the prior network, ⊖, the SDS gradient image

channels.colour: panel tint and update-arrow colour = stage (red low-res, green high-res); yellow = text conditioning; orange = rendering; the rainbow gradient on the prior networks and purple encoder carries no meaning
channels.shape: stacked slabs = network layers; wire-frame pyramid = camera; ⊕ / ⊖ circles = noise add and subtract
channels.line: grey thin arrows = noise and data paths; thick curved coloured arrows = parameter updates; big gradient arrow at the bottom = mesh extraction
channels.frame: tinted rounded panel = one optimization stage

quality.strengths: The coarse-to-fine cascade is drawn as two panels with identical internal structure differing in prior type and resolution, the 3-D representation of each stage is drawn as a real render, and the single shared prompt above both shows one condition across stages.
quality.weaknesses: The update arrows are long curves under the panels back to the representation; the networks' rainbow fill is decorative; the bottom timeline restates the stage order in a separate band of text and arrows.

insights.structure: Two tinted rounded stage panels sit left and right with large numerals '1.' and '2.', each 3D representation placed in the gap before its panel, and a bottom label row with a thick green arrow naming the representation change.
insights.data: Every 3D state is a real render of the same rabbit (octree-voxel NeRF, coloured mesh, final textured model), the prompt is quoted verbatim, and noise is a small colour-noise square above each prior.
insights.emphasis: The prompt box glows yellow and feeds both priors via thick yellow arrows, while bold 'image' vs 'latent' under the two priors marks the one change between stages.
insights.flow: Read left to right: render arrows in orange go from each 3D model into its panel, grey arrows run through noise addition, prior and subtraction to L_SDS, and a coloured arc returns 'update' to the model under the panel.
insights.avoid: The large final render at the right is bigger than both panels and the forward render arrows are faint orange, so the eye lands on the output before the method.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
